correctness.rationale: The explicit ring multiplication induces left orbit fibers D+{UC} of dimension mr and double fibers D+{UC+CV} of dimension 2mr-r². Rank-r matrices are counted by the standard N_{m,r}(q), proving both exact spectra. The factor H=P_m²/(P_r P_{m-r}²) has uniform endpoint estimates which yield theta concentration for left orbit weights and O_q(1/m) total-variation uniformity for double weights. A subspace union bound gives full rank for uniform points. Direct coset enumeration for m≤2 and independent binary 3x3 generator-span tests match the theorems.

value.rationale: The result resolves two exact rank-census problems for canonical actions on a class-two radical uniformly in matrix size and finite-field order, and proves a structurally motivated three-way change of probability law between element sampling, intrinsic brace lambda-orbit sampling, and two-sided unit-orbit sampling. A discrete theta limit and an absolutely continuous uniform limit for the same rank invariant are nontrivial consequences, not an arbitrary finite specialization or textbook rank exercise.
